title: AANCER connector (pack item kind connector, schemaVersion 1)
description: The spec of a connector item. A connector pack holds exactly one connector item, install scope, with the built connector code in content/piece.tar. Connector packs are signed by AANCER through certification: partners submit the connector source, AANCER builds, reviews and signs it.

licenceId.description: Present for a paid connector bound to one customer licence. Absent for a free connector.

pieceName.description: Package name. Partners use @aancer/piece-<name>. The part after piece- must be unique on the installation.

archive.description: Path of the application/x-tar asset that holds the built connector. Always content/piece.tar.

framework.description: major.minor of the pieces framework the connector was built against.

egressHosts.description: Hosts the connector may reach once an administrator enables it. A bare * is not allowed.

egressFromConnection.description: Take the allowed host and port from the connection the administrator creates, for systems that run at the customer.

deps.description: Signed bill of materials of the third-party runtime packages.

build.description: Build facts written by the AANCER build.
